description.value:
Range 30 feet

Duration constant

Singularity-flavored, open to all — a weak, always-on Hawking Radiation trickle: a minor passive effect against a nearby foe or in aid of a nearby ally, no Overflow draw required.

At the start of each of your turns, choose one creature within range. An enemy takes 1 void damage; an ally gains 1 temporary Hit Point until the start of your next turn. This requires no action, no save, and no Overflow draw. The damage and the temporary Hit Points each increase by 1 at 12th and again at 18th level.

cinderfall.incomplete: Passive, no-action per-turn damage to a player-chosen enemy / temp-HP to a player-chosen ally. Aura rule elements apply to every valid creature in a radius automatically -- they do not support 'the caster picks one creature each turn', so this does not fit Aura either. No selector exists for player-directed, per-turn, no-action single-target damage/healing.
